title: Weekly Regulation Monitoring Report

One LOW-risk European Commission item requires review of child-safety controls affecting Smart TV Browser/HbbTV, Voice assistant, AI features, Network services, Cybersecurity controls, OTA update, and Remote control/voice input. Set up monitoring for any EC follow-up or legislative proposals stemming from the report
